title: A microcrystalline soft carbon modified hard carbon coating enhances cycling stability and initial efficiency in natural graphite anodes
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,3635-3645
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00281H, Paper
Jiangtao Liang, Pengtao Wang, Zhuoqi Liu, Song Yang, Shoujun Liu, Junhao Liu, Xuzhong Gong
Hard-soft carbon co-coated graphite was prepared via sequential thermal polycondensation of phenolic resin and pitch, enhancing cycling stability and initial efficiency.
